papers.title: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
papers.abstract: Proposes Gaussian Spacing Normalization to give feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting a more consistent spatial reference, improving results across varying scene scales and viewpoints.

papers.title: P^2-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
papers.abstract: Jointly optimizes mixing coefficients and student weights in multi-teacher on-policy distillation, treating experts as parameter priors. Reaches balanced recovery faster than MOPD.

papers.title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
papers.abstract: Compresses LLM KV caches by predicting values from keys per attention head and applying low-rank key compression. Gains decode throughput and composes with quantization and eviction.

papers.title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
papers.abstract: Expert-verified benchmark of 90 tasks for synthesizing one image from many references, scored with graph-grounded checklists, plus an agent-harness framework for long-horizon generation.

papers.title: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
papers.abstract: Multimodal agent that pairs a global routing planner with KiCad's native router, using structured feedback to revise guides and recover from routing failures on 247 boards.

papers.title: Fast and Exact Relative-Position Attention via Structure-Aware Kernels
papers.abstract: Exact attention kernel that adds relative-position terms into FlashAttention-style tiled computation, reducing memory and compute overhead and speeding up long-sequence transformers.

papers.title: AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression
papers.abstract: Hardware-aware LLM compression using differentiable architecture search, guided by serving-engine cost models rather than parameter counts, with gains over the Minitron pruning baseline.

papers.title: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
papers.abstract: LambdaMix trains one low-rank adapter per objective over a frozen model, letting a preference vector steer behavior at inference without further optimization.

papers.title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
papers.abstract: Builds CPU-executable reasoning caches from LLM reasoning traces, reaching performance comparable to frontier models on hard tasks at a fraction of the invocation cost.

papers.title: Human-Centred, Risk-Constrained Evaluation of Financial Document Recognition: Evidence, Critical Errors, and Selective Automation
papers.abstract: Theoretical framework for judging financial document recognition by whether critical facts survive, using non-compensatory risk gates and routing uncertain cases to human review.

cc_updates.body:
What's changed
- Added Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
- Added `--settings <file>` to `claude remote-control`, which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart `claude remote-control`
- Fixed MCP OAuth requests sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them
- Fixed a case where a read-only Bash command ran outside the sandbox without a permission prompt…

What's changed
- Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier; set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` to keep using it (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
- Changed auto mode behind an LLM gateway: `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` turns on the server-side check even with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set; if managed settings set the latter, they must set the `1` too…

What's changed
- Added a record of your answer when Claude Code asks to turn on the mods it writes in a session
- Added `assume_role` on `mantle` upstreams of the Claude apps gateway, for a role in another AWS account and for per-developer AWS cost attribution
- Added an `effort` option to a mod's `$.model.fork`, so a quick side job can run at `low` whatever effort the session uses; the result reports the effort sent…
